item: {"addr": "0x140693a00", "comment": "ID 37616, from Actor::SetCriticalStage (stage stored at Actor+0xF0 first). Stage 1 (GooStart): 3D faded. Stage 2 (GooEnd) or 4 (DisintegrateEnd): stops the middle process, Set3D(actor, nullptr): the actor loses its 3D (an ash pile or goo replaces it), then KillImmediate if not yet dead. Papyrus SetCriticalStage (54747) reaches it from DLC2AttachAshPileOnDeath25/magicAttachAshPileOnDeath OnDying.
